intents.answer: Hello! I can answer quick questions about solar for your home or business, the PM Surya Ghar subsidy and site surveys. What would you like to know?

Homes with on-grid or hybrid rooftop solar get the PM Surya Ghar central subsidy: ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, up to ₹78,000. Some states add a top-up. Tell me your system size in kW (for example "3 kW") and I'll work it out.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I'd like to check my PM Surya Ghar subsidy eligibility.

intents.answer: On-grid suits homes, shops and offices with a reliable grid: lowest cost, no battery. Hybrid adds a battery for homes with frequent power cuts. Off-grid is for places with no grid connection.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, which solar system is right for my home?

intents.answer: An on-grid system switches off during a power cut, for safety. A hybrid or off-grid system switches to its battery and keeps fans, lights and the fridge running. Batteries come in lithium or tubular.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I need solar with battery backup for power cuts.

intents.answer: Solar pumps from 1 to 10 HP (AC or DC) run borewells and irrigation for heads up to 100 m, with zero running cost. We size them to your head and discharge.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I'm interested in a solar pump for my farm.

intents.answer: SAEL focuses on solar power systems: on-grid, hybrid and off-grid, for homes, businesses and industry. We don't supply solar atta chakkis or water heaters.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I have a question about solar for my home or business.

intents.answer: Dust, shading and loose connections all eat into output. Our AMC covers cleaning, checks and repairs so the system keeps yielding.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I'd like to ask about AMC and cleaning for my solar plant.

intents.answer: Our blog explains solar in plain words: subsidies, monsoon output, cleaning and more.
The price depends on system size, roof and products, so we quote after a free site survey. Share your city and monthly electricity bill on WhatsApp and we'll send an estimate.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I'd like a quote. My city: ___ , monthly bill: ₹___

intents.answer: Two options: under OpEx, investors fund the system and you pay for the power it produces. Under CapEx, you own the system and we handle installation and liaisoning end to end.
intents.whatsapp: Hi SAEL, I'd like to know about OpEx and CapEx options.

intents.answer: The site survey is free: a consultant checks your roof, shading and power bills. Book it on WhatsApp, or use the callback form.
